subject: Residential Zoning Relief Applications
overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals approved several residential zoning reliefs, including additions and front yard parking spaces, and granted a six-month variance extension for 38 Harvard Avenue.

items.title: 121 2nd Street
items.summary: Continued the hearing to the July 31, 2025 meeting at the request of the applicant.

items.title: 38 Harvard Avenue
items.summary: Approved a six-month extension on a previously granted variance to sell class two used motor vehicles.

items.title: 173 Arlington Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit to construct a rear addition that extends an existing side yard setback nonconformity.

items.title: 58 Myrtle Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit to alter and vertically expand an existing single-family residence within the side yard setback.

items.title: 141 Wall Street
items.summary: Approved a dimensional variance and a special permit to add a third floor with dormers and extend the front yard setback nonconformity.

items.title: 357 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Approved a variance to allow a parallel parking space and curb cut within the front yard setback.

items.title: 54 Murray Street
items.summary: Approved variances and a special permit to build a side addition and install a flat off-street parking space within the front yard setback.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: The board discussed the process for appointing a new member, future renewal procedures for five-year marijuana special permits, and new meeting minutes software.
